purpose: Private Scout source-planning catalogue. Entries are leads supplied for evaluation, not approved sources or legal conclusions.

scope.included_jurisdictions: Use country and subnational legal jurisdictions; Scotland is separate from the rest of the UK.
scope.coverage_note: The supplied list is a valuable starting inventory, not a complete verified European country/source matrix. Geographic Europe and transcontinental/dependent-jurisdiction boundaries vary; all listed coverage gaps need explicit disposition before Scout may claim Europe-wide coverage. Northern Ireland was not explicitly excluded and remains a gap.

activation_policy.note: Public visibility and the supplied research notes do not establish licence, reuse, automation, or legal-evidence permission. Verify exact dataset-level terms and jurisdictional meaning before activation.
